hunks.baseline: And a major one, no less—hundreds of people thrown in. My heart lurched for a moment, but then I remembered what Wipeng had said earlier.
hunks.sol: And a major one, no less—hundreds of people had fought in it. My heart lurched for a moment, but then I remembered what Wipeng had said earlier.

hunks.baseline: Good news and even better news. I’d already heard the outcome.
hunks.sol: Good news and even better news. He’d already told me the outcome.

hunks.baseline: Judging by the scar running from Wipeng’s forehead to his chin, it must have been a fierce fight.
hunks.sol: Judging by the fresh scar running from Wipeng’s forehead to his chin, it must have been a fierce battle.

hunks.baseline: Still, it was a relief we’d won. From the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s perspective, we’d poured in nearly half our strength. If we’d lost, the damage would have been enormous.
hunks.sol: Still, it was a relief we’d won. The Jin Family of Taiyuan had committed nearly half its forces to that battle. If we’d lost, the damage would have been enormous.

hunks.baseline: “It’s unfortunate we let the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s Lesser Family Head escape, but taking the Mount Heng Twin Devils was a major haul.”
hunks.sol: “It’s unfortunate that we let the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s Lesser Family Head escape, but bringing down the Mount Heng Twin Devils was a major gain.”

hunks.baseline: “The Mount Heng Twin D-Devils?”
hunks.sol: “The Mount Heng Fucking Devils?”

hunks.baseline: “The Mount Heng Twin Devils. Peak masters under the Mount Heng Sword Sect, and their loyalty was something else… They kept throwing themselves at us without any regard for their lives, so we had no choice but to kill them.”
hunks.sol: “The Mount Heng *Twin* Devils. They were Peak masters under the Mount Heng Sword Sect, and their loyalty was something else… They kept throwing themselves at us with no regard for their lives, so we had no choice but to kill them.”

hunks.baseline: Wipeng tapped the fresh scar.
hunks.sol: Wipeng tapped his new scar.

hunks.baseline: “If we’d captured them, we could have extracted some important information.”
hunks.sol: “If we’d captured them, we could have extracted important information.”

hunks.baseline: I was left speechless as Wipeng slurped his tea.
hunks.sol: I was left speechless as Wipeng sipped his tea.

hunks.baseline: It had been the fiercest fight of my twenty-seven years. All kinds of internal injuries, and I’d been sliced up like a steak. I’d been out for five days after that, so I’d practically taken a half-bath in the River Jordan.[^1]
hunks.sol: It had been the fiercest fight of my twenty-seven years. I’d suffered all kinds of internal injuries and been sliced up like a steak. Then I’d been out cold for five days, so I’d practically taken a half-bath in the River Jordan.[^1]

hunks.baseline: And after taking down Peak masters of that caliber. What, *pretty good*?
hunks.sol: And after taking down Peak masters of that caliber, all he had to say was *pretty good*?

hunks.baseline: I learned something for certain this time: even Peak masters came in different levels. It was a huge relief that people of that caliber were on my side.
hunks.sol: This had taught me one thing for certain: even Peak masters came in different tiers. Thank God people of that caliber were on my side.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng set down his teacup and looked at me with a peculiar expression.
hunks.sol: Wipeng set down his teacup and regarded me with a peculiar look.

hunks.baseline: “I’m talking about Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Defeating him isn’t something the word remarkable can even cover.”
hunks.sol: “I’m talking about Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Even calling it remarkable doesn’t do justice to what you accomplished by defeating him.”

hunks.baseline: It felt like getting praised by an A-rank Hunter for being good at killing goblins.
hunks.sol: It felt like being praised by an A-rank Hunter for being good at killing goblins.

hunks.baseline: “Ah. Yes. Thank you, I suppose.”
hunks.sol: “Ah. Yes. Thanks, I guess.”

hunks.baseline: I wanted to wrap up the Jopil talk there. My body and my mood were both in bad shape, and I wanted to check the System Rewards still waiting for me.
hunks.sol: I wanted to wrap up the Jopil talk there. My body was in bad shape, my mood wasn’t much better, and I wanted to check the System Rewards waiting for me.

hunks.baseline: *Let’s rest now. I’m still a patient, damn it.*
hunks.sol: *Let me rest already. I’m still a patient, damn it.*

hunks.baseline: I put that meaning into a wink. Wipeng frowned.
hunks.sol: I tried to convey that with a wink. Wipeng frowned.

hunks.baseline: “It was a spasm. I saw it clearly.”
hunks.sol: “It was. I saw it clearly.”

hunks.baseline: “No, just now, that was…”
hunks.sol: “No, what I just did was…”

hunks.baseline: Then Wipeng rolled his eyes back until only the whites showed and started to tremble.
hunks.sol: Then Wipeng rolled his eyes back until only the whites showed and began trembling violently.

hunks.baseline: The table shook, and tea spilled over the rim of the cup. I cried out in alarm.
hunks.sol: The table shook, and tea sloshed over the rim of his cup. I cried out in alarm.

hunks.baseline: *This guy’s epileptic. No—how does a Peak master even get epilepsy?*
hunks.sol: *This guy has epilepsy. No—how does a Peak master even get epilepsy?*

hunks.baseline: Just as I hurriedly tried to stand, the trembling stopped. Back to normal, Wipeng spoke with a perfectly calm face.
hunks.sol: Just as I hurriedly tried to stand, the trembling stopped. Perfectly composed again, Wipeng said,

hunks.baseline: *What kind of lunatic is this…*
hunks.sol: *What kind of lunatic is this…?*

hunks.baseline: I tried to explain the difference between a wink and an epileptic fit, but the words stuck. Wipeng was glaring at me like a pissed-off dictator.
hunks.sol: I tried to explain the difference between a wink and an epileptic fit, but the words died in my throat. Wipeng was glaring at me like a pissed-off dictator.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng nodded, satisfied.
hunks.sol: Wipeng nodded in satisfaction.

hunks.baseline: *You crazy bastard.*
hunks.sol: *Crazy bastard.*

hunks.baseline: In the end, I had to tell him everything about the fight with Jopil, from beginning to end.
hunks.sol: In the end, I had to tell him everything about my fight with Jopil from beginning to end.

hunks.baseline: How Jopil had moved, what martial arts he’d used. Wipeng’s sharp questions had me tensing up more than once.
hunks.sol: How Jopil had moved. What martial arts he’d used. Wipeng’s incisive questions had me tensing up more than once.

hunks.baseline: “You severed the tendons in Jopil’s legs with daggers?”
hunks.sol: “You severed the tendons in Jopil’s legs with a dagger?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I had them hidden in advance.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I’d kept it hidden beforehand.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no way Jopil failed to notice them… Continue.”
hunks.sol: “There’s no way Jopil failed to notice it… Continue.”

hunks.baseline: When the long story finally ended, Wipeng let out the breath he’d been holding. The mixed feelings in the way he looked at me came through loud and clear.
hunks.sol: When the long story finally ended, Wipeng released the breath he’d been holding. The conflicted look in his eyes told me exactly how he felt.

hunks.baseline: “Third Young Master. You have accomplished a truly great deed.”
hunks.sol: “Third Young Master, you have accomplished a truly great deed.”

hunks.baseline: “I hate to admit it, but I mean it.”
hunks.sol: “I hate to admit it, but I mean that.”

hunks.baseline: “…Ah. Yes.”
hunks.sol: “…Ah. Right.”

hunks.baseline: “When I think of all the trouble you’ve caused until now, my blood boils, but I was genuinely impressed. I mean that.”
hunks.sol: “When I think of all the trouble you’ve caused until now, my blood boils, but I was genuinely impressed. I mean it.”

hunks.baseline: “Who could have imagined that the Third Young Master who stole family funds day after day and poured them into pleasure houses, then paraded through the streets dead drunk and smeared shit all over the family’s reputation, would become such a great man? I, Wipeng, am genuinely in awe.”
hunks.sol: “Who could have imagined that the Third Young Master who stole family funds day after day and squandered them in taverns, then staggered drunkenly through the streets smearing shit all over the family’s reputation, would grow into such a great man? I, Wipeng, am genuinely in awe.”

hunks.baseline: I barely held back the stream of swearing trying to burst out and said,
hunks.sol: I barely held back the stream of profanity trying to burst out of me.

hunks.baseline: “No. It was all skill. Who let their guard down and who hid a dagger beforehand are not excuses. If that had been enough to kill Jopil, he would not have been Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Murim is a place where only the strong survive.”
hunks.sol: “No. It was all skill. Whether Jopil let his guard down or you had a dagger hidden beforehand changes nothing. If that alone had been enough to kill him, he would not have been Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Murim is a place where only the strong survive.”

hunks.baseline: I quietly rolled the words over my tongue. They tasted bitter and sweet at the same time.
hunks.sol: I quietly rolled the words over my tongue. Somehow, they tasted both bitter and sweet.

hunks.baseline: Murim—this game—had been that kind of place from the beginning. I had survived there, and I had gotten stronger.
hunks.sol: Murim—this game—had been that kind of place from the beginning. I had survived there, and I had grown stronger.

hunks.baseline: “Jopil used every martial art he possessed to its fullest. In the end, he even pulled up his innate qi. A Peak master threw away his own life trying to kill you. But what was the result?”
hunks.sol: “Jopil used every martial art he possessed to its fullest. In the end, he even drew upon his innate qi. A Peak master threw away his own life trying to kill you. But what was the result?”

hunks.baseline: Wipeng, who’d been looking sour this whole time, turned serious.
hunks.sol: Wipeng, who had looked uncomfortable for a while now, turned dead serious.

hunks.baseline: “You were only strong enough to kill Jopil in a surprise attack.”
hunks.sol: “You were only strong enough to kill Jopil with a surprise attack.”

hunks.baseline: While I was debating whether to pull a weapon from my Inventory, Wipeng let out a short chuckle. It was the first time I had ever seen him laugh.
hunks.sol: While I debated whether to pull a weapon from my Inventory, Wipeng let out a quiet laugh. It was the first time I had ever seen him laugh.

hunks.baseline: I looked at Wipeng suspiciously.
hunks.sol: I regarded him suspiciously.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “I mean it. It’s true I disliked you quite a lot, but… this time, I have no choice but to acknowledge you.”
hunks.sol: “I mean it. It’s true that I disliked you quite a lot, but… this time, I have no choice but to acknowledge you.”

hunks.baseline: When he put it like that, I had nothing to say. I got embarrassed for some reason and cleared my throat.
hunks.sol: When he put it like that, I had nothing to say. For some reason, I felt embarrassed and cleared my throat.

hunks.baseline: “How many Peak masters do you think there are in a single city? Across all of Shanxi, where our family is located, there are fewer than twenty.”
hunks.sol: “How many Peak masters do you think there are in a single city? Even across all of Shanxi, where our family is based, there are fewer than twenty.”

hunks.baseline: “The Mount Heng Sword Sect must have taken serious losses. They lost three Peak masters like that.”
hunks.sol: “The Mount Heng Sword Sect must have taken serious losses. They lost three Peak masters.”

hunks.baseline: “But the greatest blow is something else.”
hunks.sol: “But the greatest blow lies elsewhere.”

hunks.baseline: “The pretext. The pretext for starting this war is gone. The Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan is strong enough without using poison. Indeed, that’s exactly right.”
hunks.sol: “The pretext. The pretext for starting this war is gone. The Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan is strong enough without resorting to poison. Yes, indeed.”

hunks.baseline: The enormous Jin Wikyung stood there, teary-eyed, both arms spread wide.
hunks.sol: The enormous Jin Wikyung stood in the doorway, teary-eyed, with both arms spread wide.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll kill him! How dare that vicious wandering martial artist bastard! Even if I ripped out his guts and chewed them to a pulp, it wouldn’t be enough!”
hunks.sol: “I’ll kill him! How dare that vicious wandering martial artist bastard! Even ripping out his guts and chewing them to a pulp wouldn’t be enough!”

hunks.baseline: I stared blankly at the wreckage of my bedroom. Jin Wikyung had gotten way too into the story.
hunks.sol: I stared blankly at the ruins of my bedroom. Jin Wikyung had gotten far too invested in the story.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng had already backed far away and was mouthing something.
hunks.sol: Wipeng had already retreated to a safe distance and was mouthing something.

hunks.baseline: —It would be best not to bring that story up again.
hunks.sol: —It would be best not to tell that story again.

hunks.baseline: I watched with sad eyes as the corner of the bed crumbled into powder. Wipeng shook his head.
hunks.sol: I watched sadly as the corner of the bed crumbled into powder. Wipeng shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “My lord. Please calm down. The Young Master seems anxious.”
hunks.sol: “My lord, please calm down. The Young Master seems anxious.”

hunks.baseline: That one actually worked. Seeing me sitting there sadly, wrapped in bandages from head to toe, Jin Wikyung’s eyes reddened.
hunks.sol: That actually worked. Jin Wikyung’s eyes reddened when he saw me sitting there with a forlorn expression, wrapped from head to toe in bandages.

hunks.baseline: “Just look at my baby brother. How much has this child suffered, to be sitting there so out of it?”
hunks.sol: “Just look at my baby brother. How much must this young man have suffered to be sitting there in such a daze?”

hunks.baseline: *Grab!*
A hand the size of a cauldron lid seized my shoulder and yanked me in. I was a fairly big guy myself, but this man was practically a small ogre. Crushed against his broad chest, I trembled in fear.
hunks.sol: A hand the size of a cauldron lid clamped onto my shoulder and yanked me in. I was a fairly big guy myself, but this man was practically a small ogre. Crushed against his broad chest, I trembled in fear.

hunks.baseline: After a heartfelt hug that only he found moving, Jin Wikyung sniffed.
hunks.sol: After ending a heartfelt embrace that only he found moving, Jin Wikyung sniffed.

hunks.baseline: “I thought you’d be a child forever… but you’ve grown up now. Wipeng, did you know?”
hunks.sol: “I thought you’d be a child forever… but now you’re all grown up. Wipeng, did you know?”

hunks.baseline: Wipeng answered without even taking a breath.
hunks.sol: Wipeng answered without even pausing to breathe.

hunks.baseline: “Rumors have spread throughout our family and even through the streets. The tale of the hero who led a death squad in a raid on the enemy camp, defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, and one hundred wandering martial artists, and rescued the Sakju Branch’s household.”
hunks.sol: “Rumors have spread throughout our family and even into the marketplace. The tale of the hero who led a death squad in a raid on the enemy camp, defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, and a hundred wandering martial artists, and rescued the Sakju Branch’s people.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung smiled, pleased.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung smiled with satisfaction.

hunks.baseline: “Our little brother is modest, too. Wipeng, you shut your mouth.”
hunks.sol: “My baby brother is modest too. Wipeng, shut your mouth.”

hunks.baseline: “No, it isn’t modesty. I think the rumor has been distorted a little.”
hunks.sol: “No, it isn’t modesty. I think the rumor has gotten a little distorted.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. I know you care for the Young Master, my lord, but this is going too far. If the rumor gets too far-fetched, people won’t beli—”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. I know you care for the Young Master, my lord, but this is going too far. If the rumor gets too outlandish, people won’t beli—”

hunks.baseline: “Rumor? Far-fetched?”
hunks.sol: “Rumor? Outlandish?”

hunks.baseline: Wipeng’s voice vanished under the thunderous crash. I stared with my mouth hanging open at the hole blown through my bedroom wall.
hunks.sol: Wipeng’s voice vanished beneath a thunderous crash. My mouth fell open as I stared at the hole blown through my bedroom wall.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung threw another punch. With a sound like compressed air bursting, what was left of the wall came down.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung threw another punch. Compressed air burst with a deafening roar, bringing down what remained of the wall.

hunks.baseline: Wood and bricks rained from the two-story pavilion, and the people outside started shouting.
hunks.sol: Wood and bricks rained from the two-story pavilion, and the people outside began shouting.

hunks.baseline: “It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Mas—his residence is collapsing!”
hunks.sol: “It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Master’s residence is collapsing!”

hunks.baseline: While everyone was still stuck in shock, Jin Wikyung hoisted me into the air.
hunks.sol: While everyone was still reeling from the shock, Jin Wikyung hoisted me into the air.

hunks.baseline: I struggled with all my strength, but there was no fighting him off. One step. One step. Every step toward the gaping wall sent terror through me.
hunks.sol: I struggled with all my strength, but there was no fighting him off. One step. Then another. Every step he took toward the gaping wall sent a fresh wave of terror through me.

hunks.baseline: More than fifty people had gathered below. It was two stories in name, but the pavilion was so huge the drop was a good ten meters. The wind coming through made me dizzy.
hunks.sol: More than fifty people had gathered below. It was only two stories in name—the pavilion was so huge that the drop was a good ten meters. The wind rushing past me made my head spin.

hunks.baseline: *If I fall, that’s a fracture at the very least.*
hunks.sol: *If I fall, I’m breaking bones at the very least.*

hunks.baseline: Even with a chill running down my spine, people kept packing in. More than fifty of them had their heads cranked back, looking up at us.
hunks.sol: Even as a chill ran down my spine, more people kept crowding in. Over fifty heads craned back to look up at us.

hunks.baseline: Someone’s shout sent a stir through the crowd.
hunks.sol: The shout sent a stir through the crowd.

hunks.baseline: “The Third Young Master—no, the Third Young Master, sir?”
hunks.sol: “The Third Young Master? No—Lord Third Young Master?”

hunks.baseline: *What is this situation?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is happening?*

hunks.baseline: While my eyes and ears were still whipping around, a solemn voice rang out clearly.
hunks.sol: My head spun as I tried to take in everything I was seeing and hearing. Then a solemn voice rang out clearly.

hunks.baseline: That last curse vanished, swallowed by the crowd’s shouts.
hunks.sol: That last curse vanished beneath the crowd’s shouts.

hunks.baseline: Dozens more had shown up in that brief interval. Countless eyes came flying at me and stuck.
hunks.sol: Dozens more had appeared in that brief interval. Countless gazes flew up and pinned me in place.

hunks.baseline: *No, what is this?*
hunks.sol: *No, what the hell is this?*

hunks.baseline: Then, with a solemn face, Jin Wikyung shoved his hands into my armpits and lifted me high.
hunks.sol: Then, wearing a solemn expression, Jin Wikyung slid his hands under my armpits and lifted me high.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck. What is this, a baby lion?*
hunks.sol: *Fuck. What am I, a baby lion?*
